mentions.description: This is an AI agent, in the style of Cursor, for planning hikes and trips. It performs context management, makes tool calls into data sources, and navigates the world to find interesting places. The project is leaving private beta this week.

mentions.name: Wanderfugl
mentions.description: An LLM-powered map application that reinvents how mapping apps interact with geocoders and routing engines, aiming to make map applications more powerful and easier to use.
mentions.problem: Mapping applications are limited by how they interact with geocoders and routing engines, making them less powerful and harder to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building an LLM powered map for the last 6 months.  I'm working to reinvent how mapping applications interact with geocoders and routing engines to make much more powerful and easy to use map applications!
